objective: Put a show in the sanctuary and the studio on display.
location: Lunde Records Studio · The Old Church · Streamed Live

concept.headline: A show in the sanctuary. A studio on display.
concept.body: Lunde Records Studio lives in an old church. The open floor and the lobby are the room — high ceilings, long sightlines, built for a congregation and now for a crowd. The Service runs the Rolled & Recorded format inside it: sets that flow into each other, a podcast-room feed between them, four cameras rolling. And while the music plays, the studio shows its work — the rooms, the gear, the people who record there. Come for the show. Leave knowing what gets made in this building.
concept.note: Session 02 of the series. Format proven at First Light; this one proves the room.
